name: rhapsody-design-assistant
description: Generate Detailed Design artifacts from requirements, via GitHub Copilot

rhapsody.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python interpreter used to run the design tools. Leave empty to use the environment created by **Rhapsody: Set Up Python Environment**.

rhapsody.basePythonPath.markdownDescription: Python 3.10+ used to *create* the managed virtual environment. Leave empty to auto-detect (`py -3`, `python`, `python3`).

rhapsody.runtimeDir.markdownDescription: Folder for runtime outputs (checkpoints, intermediate JSON, Mermaid files). Keep it outside OneDrive. Default: `C:\RhapsodyAIAgent_runtime`. Requires a window reload.

rhapsody.toolsRoot.markdownDescription: Advanced: folder containing a `tools/` directory to use instead of the tools bundled with the extension (useful while developing). Requires a window reload.

commands.name: design
commands.description: Generate design for a component: /design <component> [srs=<SRS package name>]

author: JIO2KOR
